name: outcry
note: A trading floor before screens: ledger paper, ink, and one brass fitting. Every value here appears verbatim in src/util/fmt.ts, src/floorview/index.html and assets/*.svg — there is no second palette anywhere in the repository.

chroma_rule.statement: Brass is spent on decisions, never on moods.
brass_is_for: a section a seat is acting in
loss_is_never_for: a warning that is not a loss
chroma_rule.gain: declared and almost unused: a winning position is ink on paper with no colour at all. Profit is not green.

typography.family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
typography.note: One face. This is a terminal product and a ledger; a proportional face would misalign every column it has.
typography.caps: Section labels and the wordmark only. Tickers are data, not emphasis, and stay as they are.

shape.note: Zero rounded corners, zero shadows, zero gradients. Depth is surface tone plus one hairline, the way a printed form has depth.

surfaces.page: paper, with a 4px repeating hairline at 1.4% ink — ledger ruling, not texture
surfaces.seat: sunk when idle, panel with a brass border when the seat is acting

where: the gate box in the banner
polarity_flip.note: Brass ground with on-brass text. Everything else stays ink on paper.
